items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot bounded public beta or full launch; keep_private. Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights, while public terms restrict commercial/public reuse. Legal tracking is active with 0/4 tasks closed. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with 20 open banner/accept/reject/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Security, operations, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send rights outreach, and allow only bounded reversible growth that adds no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or unsupported claims.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: 0/4 legal tasks closed; no task is closed because evidence is incomplete. Source-rights evidence confirms access only; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/request procedures. Route unresolved rights, jurisdiction, processor, and monetization questions to human counsel.

Launch-readiness data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data = blocked; current rights do not support proposed public display, historical derivatives, caching, alerts, or possible affiliate/advertising use. User alert rules and sync results = counsel_required; personal-data inventory, retention/deletion/correction/access controls, Slack processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are missing. GA4 = conditional; measurement-only, consent-gated use is described, but deployed consent behavior, GA4 settings, retention, and jurisdiction review are missing. Operational logs and Cloudflare data = evidence_needed; log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures are missing. Smallest next action for all items: complete the dated read-only evidence bundle, then escalate unresolved legal or jurisdictional questions to human counsel. Do not treat site terms as upstream data permission or incomplete telemetry as proof of compliance.
